reason: I already have a collagen tub from Amazon that does the job and it's cheaper per gram, and £18 for 300g with no free delivery under £30 feels steep on my salary. Halal is nice, but honestly I haven't been checking so it's not enough to make me switch this week.
objection: I could get a bigger tub cheaper on Amazon with next-day delivery, and I've never heard of RizqPure, so the 4.8 stars on their own site don't mean much to me.
would_change_my_mind: Finding out my current collagen definitely isn't halal, plus seeing RizqPure on Amazon at a similar price per gram with Prime delivery.
